subject: TRIM function
notes: All three of r4's antecedents measured through FUNCTION LENGTH of the RESULT — the only instrument that can see a zero-length return, since a MOVE receiver's own space filling (§14.9.25.4 GR6a) renders an empty result and a correct one identically. ALLSP/LEAD/TRAIL/ALLA2/ZEROL = 00 with CTRL=02 as the live-channel control; two editions because the explicit argument-2 leg is 2023-only (Annex E.3.3 item 31).
